greeting: Hi — I’m the Weluxo assistant. I can help with products, stock, shipping, returns, payments, policies, and general store questions.

entries.title: Product guidance
entries.content: For product-specific guidance, the assistant uses the current product title, description, price, and stock shown in Weluxo's approved store catalog. If those details do not answer the question, the assistant connects the customer with support.

entries.title: Shipping times and delivery estimates
entries.content: Delivery timing varies by product, destination, fulfillment partner, carrier, and customs processing. The delivery estimate shown at checkout and in the customer's order information is the applicable estimate; Weluxo does not promise one universal delivery time.

entries.title: International shipping availability
entries.content: Weluxo serves customers in multiple markets. Shipping availability, available methods, cost, and timing depend on the product and destination and are confirmed at checkout.

entries.title: Tracking an order
entries.content: When a tracking number is created, available updates can be viewed through the customer's account and the tracking page. Carrier scans can take time to appear. For a specific order, Weluxo must verify the order number and checkout email before sharing details.

entries.title: Shipping costs
entries.content: Available shipping methods and costs are shown at checkout. Rates can vary by destination, product, package characteristics, carrier option, and the offer displayed at the time of purchase.

entries.title: Return eligibility
entries.content: Customers should contact Weluxo support within 30 days of delivery to ask whether an order is eligible for return. Items should generally be unused, complete, and in their original condition and packaging where possible. Eligibility can vary by product and fulfillment partner.

entries.title: How to request a return
entries.content: To request a return, contact support with the order number, product details, and reason for the request. Support will confirm eligibility and provide any applicable instructions before the item is sent back.

entries.title: Refund process
entries.content: After a returned item is received and reviewed, Weluxo or the applicable fulfillment partner determines whether the return is approved. An approved refund is sent to the original payment method. The time for funds to appear depends on the payment provider and banking process.

entries.title: Damaged, defective, or wrong item
entries.content: If an item arrives damaged, defective, or different from what was ordered, contact support promptly with the order number, a description of the issue, and clear photos or video when useful. Keep the item and packaging until support provides instructions.

entries.title: Changing or cancelling an order
entries.content: Contact support as soon as possible with the order number and requested change or cancellation. Weluxo cannot guarantee changes or cancellation after an order has entered fulfillment or shipped.

entries.title: Payments and checkout
entries.content: Available payment methods are displayed securely during checkout and can vary by destination. If a payment fails, confirm the payment details, try another available method, or contact the payment provider or Weluxo support if the issue continues.

entries.title: Order confirmation email
entries.content: If a customer cannot find an order confirmation email, they should check spam or promotions first. If it is still missing, support can help when the customer provides the email and order details used at checkout.

entries.title: Account help
entries.content: Customers can create an account from the Account area, use the password reset option on the sign-in page, and update account information after signing in to profile settings.
